---
name: Content request
about: Request a copy change, member add, contribution add, or seed update
title: "[Content] "
labels: content
---

**What kind of change?**
- [ ] Copy tweak (typo, wording)
- [ ] Add a member
- [ ] Add a contribution
- [ ] Add or edit a seed (vision quote)
- [ ] Other

**Where does it go?**
e.g. page name, section, Notion DB

**The content**
Paste the new text, or describe the change.

**Notes for the steward making the change**
Anything that helps them get it right (context, source, attribution).
